author: Scout
details: Wait once until Pacific operating time on the selected exchange session, respecting calendar and DST.
Read current recipe and compatibility at wake before broker preflight, provider or workers. Ctrl-C cancels pending startup.
Scout selected-day automatic stop and existing after-close immediate stop preserved; no automatic daily restart.
limitations: Offline lifecycle fixtures only; no live broker/provider request, trader activation, order or peer runtime verification.
runtime_implications: Exact source locally installed on Scout; subsequent manual launches use interruptible waiting. Atlas applicability is shared source with independent local installation. Manual stop and first forecast policy are preserved.
summary: Shared manual 15m early launches wait for their exchange session before operating startup
